opening_filter: Twenty named opening families, two seeded quiet continuations each, sorted legal move choices. No evaluator queried or evaluation/outcome filter. Frozen before games; nested prefixes; reversed colors.

stop_amendment.instruction: actually stop at 35 games, no need for 60
stop_amendment.method: Human-requested mid-run stop. Study process tree stopped after the atomic 35-game checkpoint. Original 60-game checkpoint/plan retained; no automatic outcome-based stopping or extra completed games. Game 35 reported separately from paired uncertainty.

summary.uncertainty_method: Hoeffding bounded pair-score 95% interval; nominal independent opening pairs
summary.limitations: Frozen evaluator-neutral opening book; capped pairs excluded from complete-pair inference; no universal Elo claim. Null rating endpoints mean unbounded tails.
